title: Azusawa Kohane — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! Sorry to have kept you waiting. I'm here now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An!
Wait, where are Shinonome and Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They went ahead to Dad's place to get things ready, but said we can take our time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ah, that's right. Mizuki told me to give you this.
Here, it's a hair accessory!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! What a cute hair ribbon! It's so gorgeous... I wonder if it would look good on me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course it would! You're cute, and what's more, Mizuki picked it out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, and I bet Mizuki would be super happy if you sent over a picture of you wearing it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Will do! I'm a little embarrassed to... But I'll send a thank-you message along with it.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hell...oh!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! Everything's so beautifully decorated!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, looks like our star of the day has arrived.

rows.Speaker: EVER Members
rows.Line: Hey! Thanks for inviting us to the party.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tono! Oh, everyone from EVER is here too! Thank you all so much for coming.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Well, we do put on events together, and plus An wanted us to come.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, Tono. You've still got some decorations to put up. I've already finished my side.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, my bad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? So you guys helped with the decorations too?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We were getting bored just standing around and waiting, so Shinonome made us his errand boys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Making me out to be the bad guy, huh. You're the ones who offered to help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you everyone!
And thank you for doing all this, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, it's your birthday today, so don't go around trying to help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Well if you really don't mind. I'm looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! By the way, where are Toya and Kotaro?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Right here! We've got several freshly-made dishes waiting here, so if anyone's free, we'd appreciate help taking them to the tables!

rows.Speaker: EVER Members
rows.Line: On it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa's already here. Shall we bring out the centerpiece yet?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Alright! Toya, help me carry it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...
The centerpiece?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, is everyone here now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... I did tell Taiga that there was going to be a party today...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If he can make it then I'm sure he'll be here at some point. Here, would you mind putting these plates on that table?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Got it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, make way! Giant cake coming through!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa, what a huge shortcake!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. Shiraishi made it especially for today. It really is the centerpiece of the table.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you think? Doesn't it look great?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It is, but how did you manage...
Oh! Don't tell me you've been working on this since yesterday?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You got me. I may not have slept much last night, but it's the least I could do for my amazing partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much, An. I'm so grateful!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, you're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, and also, the ingredients to make all this food was from friends from around town!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When I told them your birthday was coming up, suddenly everyone started giving me all sorts of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They did that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Like the strawberries on the cake were from the person at the crepe shop and the old lady at the fruit shop! They even said that they'll give us a free treat the next time we visit them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Hehe, then that means I'm going to have to stop by to thank them.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What's this? Looks like the party's barely started.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Taiga, you made it!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yes, well, I couldn't turn down an offer from the birthday girl, could I?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, it seems like everyone we invited is here now, so let's raise a toast!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Great! Please, do the honors!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An's Father & Taiga
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (First my classmates and everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime, and now An and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't believe I got the chance to celebrate my birthday with so many people...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It makes me...so happy!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kohane, thanks for that picture of you wearing the ribbon! You look way cuter in it than I could ever imagine! I hope you keep wearing it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Azusawa. I'm glad you liked the birthday video.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like I said in the video, thank you for always coming to see our shows. It's a joy to have a fan like you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We promise to give it our utmost every day, so you better be watching us with bated breath!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're always welcome to come visit us at the Wonder Stage! Happy, happy, happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane! I'm so glad our little rooftop surprise went well. Thank you everyone for helping out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. We wanted to celebrate Kohane's birthday, too. Many fun and heated debates went into choosing your gift.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We heard how serious you are about singing, so we wanted our gift to be both practical and helpful in a professional sense. Then, we all came up with ideas to consider with scrutiny!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. Kohane, when it comes to self-care, don't hesitate to ask us anything. I'm sure our gift will come in very handy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, happy birthday, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, Kohane. I'm glad we got to celebrate together and surprise you with Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha. Good thing we made a mad dash for it after school, right, Shiho?♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why're you looking at me? Wasn't it you and the others who suggested the Phenny plushie in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, that may be true, but you were the one who did a ton of research on Phenny merch, and picked out the one we ended up giving her!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, who wouldn't make sure the recipient actually likes their gift? Anyway, happy birthday, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Azusawa. As Tono and the others said, I'm happy to have helped put this party together and see you enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Seeing your adorable face munching away on that slice of cake was totally worth the all-nighter!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I saw An off to one side watching you with a grin on her face as you dug in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey now. Seeing my partner smile like that was seeing how all my hard work paid off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! I know I say this all the time, but you are the best partner I could have ever asked for.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know there'll be a lot of hurdles between us and our goal to surpass RAD WEEKEND, but I'll do my best. Someday, we'll all achieve that dream together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My school friends, teammates, and even the locals...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So many people helped put these celebrations together. It's like I'm dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for celebrating my birthday with me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm going to keep doing my best! To surpass RAD WEEKEND and for all of those people who come watch us perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I hope you all continue to support me. Thank you so much for today!
